outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches its outer edge, then raises the door toward the oven during frames 41–60. By frames 61–77, left_ego_image shows the door upright against the oven front, with the blue dish visible through the glass; image also shows the previously projecting door closed. The gripper withdraws by frame 77 without the door reopening. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
